create or replace function public.can_read_project_file(path text)
returns boolean as $$
declare
  proj_id bigint;
  org_id_val bigint;
begin

  proj_id := (split_part(path, '/', 1))::bigint;

  from public.projects p

create or replace function public.is_only_owner(p_org_id bigint, p_user_id uuid)
returns boolean as $$
declare
  owner_count int;
begin
  select count(*) into owner_count
  from public.org_members
  where org_id = p_org_id and role = 'owner';
  
  return owner_count = 1 and exists (
    select 1 from public.org_members
    where org_id = p_org_id and user_id = p_user_id and role = 'owner'
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

returns text as $$
declare
  user_role text;
begin
  select role into user_role
  from public.org_members
  where org_id = p_org_id and user_id = p_user_id;

end;

on public.approvers
for select

on public.purchase_orders
for select
to authenticated

  requester_id = auth.uid() 
  OR 
  exists (select 1 from public.approvers where user_id = auth.uid())
);

on public.purchase_orders
for insert
to authenticated

on public.purchase_orders
for update
to authenticated

  requester_id = auth.uid() 
  AND 
  NOT public.is_po_decided(id)
);

-- R2: Users can delete their own POs until decided
create policy "purchase_orders_delete_own_undecided"
on public.purchase_orders
for delete
to authenticated
using (
  requester_id = auth.uid() 
  AND 
  NOT public.is_po_decided(id)
);

-- ==========================================

on public.po_approvals
for select
to authenticated
using (
  exists (select 1 from public.purchase_orders where id = po_id and requester_id = auth.uid())
  OR
  exists (select 1 from public.approvers where user_id = auth.uid())
);

-- R4: Decisions can never be changed or deleted (handled by omitting update/delete policies for authenticated)

on public.po_approvals
for insert
to authenticated

  exists (select 1 from public.approvers where user_id = auth.uid())

  -- Must be recording as themselves
  approver_id = auth.uid()
  AND
  -- PO must not already be decided (enforced by PK constraint mostly, but logical check)
  NOT public.is_po_decided(po_id)
  AND
  -- Cannot approve own request

  AND
  -- Amount must be within approver's limit

);

to authenticated
using (false);

on public.po_approvals
for delete
to authenticated
using (false);

grant select, insert, update, delete on public.purchase_orders to authenticated;

revoke all on table public.purchase_orders from anon;
revoke all on table public.po_approvals from anon;

  v_min_required numeric;

  -- Check if user is authenticated (R4)
  if not public.is_authenticated() then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  -- Get auction details

  -- Check if auction exists (R4)

    raise exception 'Auction does not exist';
  end if;

    raise exception 'Auction has ended';
  end if;

  -- Check if caller is the seller (R4)

    raise exception 'Sellers cannot bid on their own auctions';
  end if;

  -- Calculate minimum required bid
  if not v_auction_rec.has_bids then
    v_min_required := v_auction_rec.start_price;
  else
    v_min_required := v_auction_rec.current_high + v_auction_rec.min_inc;
  end if;

  values (p_auction_id, auth.uid(), p_amount, now());

  -- Update the auction's highest bid
  update public.auctions
  set highest_bid = p_amount,
      highest_bidder = auth.uid()
  where id = p_auction_id;

  return p_amount;
end;

alter table public.profiles enable row level security;

create function public.is_owner_or_visibility_allowed(target_visibility text)
returns boolean as $$
begin
  -- Service role bypasses this check implicitly via RLS policies that check auth.role()
  -- But for function logic used in policies:
  if auth.role() = 'service_role' then
    return true;
  end if;

  -- If no user is logged in (anon)
  if auth.uid() is null then
    return target_visibility = 'public';
  end if;

  -- If user is logged in
  if target_visibility = 'public' then
    return true;
  elsif target_visibility = 'members' then
    return true;
  elsif target_visibility = 'private' then
    -- Only owner can see private
    return false; -- This function is for read access by others, owner check is separate
  end if;

  return false;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- Policy for SELECT (Read)
-- R1: Anyone can read public profiles.
-- R2: Signed-in users can read members-only profiles. Private profiles visible only to owner.
create policy "Profiles are viewable based on visibility and ownership"
on public.profiles
for select
using (
  -- Service role has full access
  auth.role() = 'service_role'
  OR
  -- Case 1: Profile is public (visible to everyone including anon)
  visibility = 'public'
  OR
  -- Case 2: Profile is members-only (visible to any authenticated user)
  (visibility = 'members' AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL)
  OR
  -- Case 3: Profile is private (visible only to owner)
  (visibility = 'private' AND user_id = auth.uid())
);

-- R3: Users can create only their own profile.
-- R4: Anonymous visitors cannot create profiles.

on public.profiles
for insert
with check (
  -- Service role has full access
  auth.role() = 'service_role'
